John B. Goodenough was elected a Foreign Member of the Royal Society in 2010. The team note is half right: he was born in Jena, Germany, but he did not spend his career at one British university, since he worked at MIT Lincoln Laboratory and the University of Texas at Austin, with a period at Oxford in between. I did not re-check the Royal Society page in this session, so the 2010 date rests on my earlier recall.

CONFIDENCE: 85
